newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Metlife to set up local Botswana operation.
newsitem.headline: Metlife to set up local Botswana operation.

text.p: Life insurer Metropolitan Life Ltd said on Wednesday it would establish a fully fledged local operation in Botswana early next year in a joint venture with the Botswana Development Corporation (BDC).
The group said in a statement the BDC would have a 25 percent stake in the new company, Metropolitan Life of Botswana Limited.
The move followed the setting up of Metlife's health care subsidiary, FirstHealth Medical Administrators, in Botswana last September.

"We are still in the process of registering the new company and our decision to establish a base in Botswana was taken after a thorough investigation of market conditions there," Metlife Managing Director Marius Smith said.
Apart from operations in Lesotho, Namibia and soon in Botswana, the group was investigating opportunities in Kenya and further afield, he added.
